poses: Front squat: bar in front rack across front shoulders, elbows high, deep squat, heels planted.
Romanian deadlift: standing with hips hinged backward, slight knee bend, neutral back, arms straight, bar near mid-shins, not a squat.
Sumo deadlift: front three-quarter view, very wide stance with toes outward, both hands gripping bar between knees, straight arms, plates at floor.
Bent-over barbell row: hinged torso about 45 degrees, bent elbows pulling bar toward lower ribs, knees slightly bent.
Standing overhead barbell press: upright athlete, both hands holding bar just above head, upper arms raised, elbows slightly bent, no bar through head.
Barbell reverse lunge: bar on upper back, front knee bends 90 degrees, rear knee lowered near ground, feet separated front/back.
Barbell hip thrust: shoulders on low bench, feet planted, knees bent 90 degrees, hips raised horizontally, bar with pad across hips.
Standing barbell curl: elbows fixed beside torso, both forearms bent up, bar held near upper abdomen, upright straight legs.
Lying triceps extension with short bar: supine on bench, upper arms vertical, elbows bent, bar above forehead with clearance, feet planted.
Flat dumbbell bench press: lying supine on flat bench, feet grounded, elbows bent about90degrees, one dumbbell in each hand above chest.
Incline dumbbell bench press: athlete supported by clearly inclined 40degree bench back, feet planted, two dumbbells raised above upper chest, elbows bent.
Flat dumbbell fly: supine on bench, three-quarter view, arms spread wide at chest height with a slight elbow bend, one dumbbell per hand, palms facing inward.
Seated dumbbell shoulder press: upright torso on seated bench with vertical backrest, both elbows bent outward, dumbbells just above shoulders.
Standing dumbbell lateral raise: frontal view, both arms extending out to sides about shoulder height, slight elbow bend, dumbbells held outward.
Standing dumbbell front raise: side three-quarter view, both arms raised straight in front to shoulder height, dumbbells at hands, upright torso.
Single-arm dumbbell row: one knee and same-side hand on flat bench, other foot planted, back flat, other elbow pulled behind torso lifting dumbbell beside ribs.
Standing hammer curl: elbows by sides, two dumbbells raised toward shoulders, neutral vertical grips with thumb upward, no supinated grip.
Seated two-hand dumbbell overhead triceps extension: torso upright, both hands gripping one dumbbell behind head, upper arms pointing up, elbows visibly bent.
Lat pulldown: seated on padded seat with thighs restrained, hands wide on overhead cable bar, elbows bent down, bar near upper chest, cable and tall pulley visible.
Seated cable row: seated with knees slightly bent and feet on footplates, torso upright, elbows pulled back with handle near abdomen, low horizontal cable visible.
Standing cable fly: between two simple tall cable uprights, staggered stance, both arms curved inward holding handles in front of chest, cables to side pulleys.
Cable triceps pushdown: standing before high pulley, elbows fixed at sides and forearms extended downward, short bar near hips, cable from overhead.
Cable biceps curl: standing facing low pulley, upper arms by sides, forearms bent upward gripping short bar, cable rising from floor pulley.
Cable face pull: standing with rope handle pulled to eye height, elbows high and bent outward, horizontal cable to chest-height pulley.
45-degree leg press: athlete seated/reclined in sled machine, back supported, hips and knees bent, feet on large angled footplate, rails visible.
Seated leg extension: sitting on machine with vertical backrest, thighs on seat, shins extended forward lifting roller pad near ankles, hands at seat handles.
Prone leg curl: lying facedown along padded bench, knees bent so feet lifted toward buttocks, roller pad resting behind ankles, thighs still on bench.
Pull-up: both hands on horizontal overhead bar, elbows bent, chin above bar, feet lifted with knees slightly bent.
Push-up: side view, hands and toes grounded, body straight from head to heels, elbows bent lowering chest close to ground.
Parallel-bar dips: both hands on two parallel bars at hip sides, feet suspended, elbows bent about90degrees, torso leaning slightly forward.
Bulgarian split squat: front foot planted and knee bent, rear foot resting on a low bench behind athlete, hips lowered, no weights.
Goblet squat: holding one vertical dumbbell with both hands in front of chest, deep squat, elbows inside knees, heels grounded.
Kettlebell swing: three-quarter side view, athlete with soft knees and hips extending, both straight arms holding one kettlebell in front at chest height, back neutral.
Standing calf raise: athlete upright on small step, heels lifted clearly above step edge, tiptoes supporting body, no squat.
Forearm plank: side view, forearms and toes grounded, elbows under shoulders, straight body line, no hand-supported pushup.
Sit-up: sitting partway up from supine, knees bent and feet planted, arms crossed on chest, torso about45degrees to floor.
